summary: A Yes vote creates a special parcel tax of $0.07 per square foot of improvements for 12 years, estimated to raise about $6.3 million annually, to fund grants for performing arts organizations, art projects, community festivals, and arts operating and capital expenses.

tax.text: The source urges voters to support Measure Y, a parcel tax intended to fund Berkeley arts organizations and programs.
tax.quote: You can show that support in a simple way by adding your name to a Berkeley coalition working to pass Measure Y.

tax.text: A No vote would reject the ordinance creating a parcel tax to fund arts institutions and programs.
tax.quote: Initiative Petition – Ordinance Creating a Parcel Tax to Fund Arts Institutions and Programs
